coordinateSystem.note: Babylon/Three conversion adapters must explicitly transform coordinates, winding, tangent space and animation orientation. Validate in both.

ability_matrix.default_baseline: 230 active, 161 proposed; verify at integration time

biome_triad.baseline: six registered worlds; environment surface extension is a separate integration artifact

aetherion.runtime: Babylon.js MMO in game/ and separate Three.js Ability Matrix sandbox
aetherion.authority: Server/host authoritativeness to be established via game/CONTRACTS.md; do not assume UCSM alone is network server authority

ownership.ability_matrix_ucsm: combat statuses, reaction rules, ownership, kill/secondary gameplay effects
ownership.arsenal_forge: equipment definitions, sockets and attack geometry source data
ownership.combat_dynamics_lab: presentation cues and deterministic hit geometry instrumentation; no unsolicited damage
ownership.character_forge: meshes, skeletons, motion clips, bodies, sockets; no damage authority
ownership.aetherion_host: world scheduling, entity IDs, network/game state and runtime adapters

requirements: Emit idempotent events using stable eventId and castId
Pin any external reference by commit and path during integration
Do not emit kill/damage from presentation-only effects
All runtime entity and asset IDs are stable and namespaced
Provide compatible Three.js and Babylon.js adapters or document a verified shared glTF pathway
Never treat world properties as combat statuses without bridge-level mapping
Maintain versioned serialization, migration and deterministic test fixtures
